'''2016 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
